items: 【Size Information】3 feet (36 inches) long. 0.38 inch diameter. Each garden pole weighs 2.12 ounces and is made of premium quality steel. The package contains 25 pcs sturdy garden stakes for plants. We have improved our products. New and old versions are delivered randomly.

【Durable and Sturdy】The inner pole is made of high quality steel, and the pipe wall is thickened, which makes the tomato stake more difficult to deform. The exterior is made of plastic coating, and the spiral design on the surface is more convenient to use.

【Easy to Install】Drill a hole deep enough in the soil and insert the garden stake into the soil. You can use a rope to fix the plant and the garden stakes together. The green surface can perfectly blend with the plants so that they are not easy to see. Don't worry, they will not fade. Besides, it is easy to cut the length as you want.

items.label: 【Widely Use
items.value: 】These garden stakes can help plants grow in the right direction.They are very suitable for tomato stakes, eggplant stakes,cucumber stakes and grape stakes. Different sizes meet your different needs. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use. They are the best choice for your plant.

items: 【About Us】FEED GARDEN provides quality products and efficient after-sales service.If you're not satisfied with our metal garden stakes,please contact us, we will provide you with a solution as soon as possible.
